title: 行頭排
subject: a 42-year-old office worker who last played trombone in his school band in 1999, roped in by his niece, drum major of a Tuen Mun youth marching band, when the band's only trombonist flies to Osaka for Lunar New Year; marching in the front row of the Lunar New Year night parade in Tsim Sha Tsui he misses her whistle to halt, plays on alone into a squad of American cheerleaders, and ducks to the roadside until his band's bass drum catches up
caption: Cantonese 2-Tone ska, late-70s British ska revival in the Coventry mould. A clipped upstroke electric guitar skanking on every off-beat, a buzzy Vox Continental organ doubling the skank and stabbing short fills, a walking melodic bass, tight drums driving a rimshot snare backbeat on two and four under quick closed hi-hats, and a two-piece horn section of trombone and tenor saxophone playing unison riffs and one short trombone solo. Dry, punchy live-room recording with the band bleeding into each other's mics, no gloss. A cheeky male baritone, half-sung and half-spoken like Hong Kong shop patter, with band members shouting answers in the chorus. 152 BPM, Bb major. Brisk, cheeky, red-faced parade-night mix-up. No reggae one-drop, no distorted ska-punk guitars, no pop-punk, no synth pads, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
年廿八 外甥女打電話嚟
「舅父 你中學係咪吹過長號」
屯門個少年樂隊 得一個長號仔
佢成家人 年三十 要飛去大阪

[Pre-Chorus]
衣櫃頂 拎咗個長號箱落嚟
上一次打開 係一九九九

[Chorus]
推出去 拉返嚟
支管咁長 一定行頭排
前面淨係得 外甥女支棍
後面廿個細路 跟住嚟

[Verse]
借咗套制服 細咗兩個碼
件褸扣唔埋 頂帽細到坐喺頭頂
年初一夜晚 廣東道
兩邊啲人 企到成十幾層

[Pre-Chorus]
佢話 銀雞一響 就要原地踏步
我話 得啦 你放心啦

[Chorus]
推出去 拉返嚟
四十二歲 行頭排
啲閃光燈 一路對住我閃
銀雞響咗 我聽唔到

[Verse]
一路吹到 海防道轉角
點解成條街 得返我一支長號
轉頭一望 成隊樂隊唔見咗
原來我 行咗入美國啦啦隊中間

[Bridge]
三十個彩球 喺我面前搖
我縮埋路邊 等我哋個大鼓
佢支棍一指 我即刻歸隊

[Chorus]
推出去 拉返嚟
四十二歲 企返頭排
外甥女喺前面 頭都冇擰過
睇佢個背 就知佢笑到震

[Outro]
收隊嗰陣 啲細路叫我 啦啦隊舅父
下年 我實聽銀雞
